trails.title: "New Age Market Incident" Report
trails.description: The more dangerous it is, the more praises it brings ...

content.text:
Relying on the help of Ms. Maich, a citizen of the New Age Market, the support team successfully entered the "Underground Market." During the investigation, smoke from a fire suddenly rose from a forest 1.3 miles away from there. At the site, we found an injured Foundation investigator (Matilda Bouanich), a critically injured adult male arcanist (Joe Brown), a male human corpse (Harvey Hollick), and a female enemy suspected of belonging to Manus Vindictae (identity unknown).

    This woman's mystical abilities far exceeded our expectations. The spells she used were extremely dangerous and difficult to understand. We were engaged in an unprecedentedly fierce battle ... Fortunately, we can confirm that the battle with Matilda Bouanich, Joe Brown, and their group had significantly drained her energy; otherwise, we might have faced a deadly confrontation ... After a second round of attrition, her arcane skills weakened, and with the help of the people summoned by Joe Brown, we gained an initial advantage. We planned to carry out a feasible capture plan to extract important information about Manus Vindictae. However, Manus Vindictae retreated much faster than usual, leaving behind a few mindless followers who hindered our plan. Additionally, due to the fog and some unknown rare incantations, the tracking arcane skills we had prepared in advance were rendered ineffective at the site ...

"Razor" Squad

Reporter: Todd Smith

items.text: Ward, Laplace Rehab Center

items.speaker: Cateye Wisen
items.text: *cries* Boss! What's in it for you to join the Foundation?! You know they're all liars!

items.speaker: Cateye Wisen
items.text: Those, those holier-than-thou officials, they never tell us what's really going on.

items.speaker: Cateye Wisen
items.text: Besides, if Legers is taking over the restaurant—
He clutches at J's clothes, unwilling to let go.

items.speaker: "Razor" Soldier II
items.text: Hey, watch your mouth, kid! Your boss would've been hacked to pieces if it weren't for us!
J bends down and places his hands on the boy's shoulders.

items.speaker: J
items.text: Wipe your nose, kid. Legers will be a good boss. Promise.

items.speaker: J
items.text: He'll clean up the mess on Haight Street. And after that, the poorhouse staff will get you into school.

items.speaker: J
items.text: And Hollick's bike ... It's yours now.
Everyone falls quiet.

items.speaker: Cateye Wisen
items.text: So, what're you gonna do now?

items.speaker: J
items.text: Me?

items.speaker: J
items.text: I'm gonna jump into the sea and try to swim.

items.speaker: Cateye Wisen
items.text: What do you mean, boss? I thought you didn't know how to swim.
An all-too-familiar face emerges on the bed beside them.

items.speaker: Becket
items.text: Shut up, you noisy bastards! I'm trying to sleep here!

items.speaker: Gio
items.text: You shut up! Your snoring could cause a freaking earthquake!
The two men with their heads bandaged bump foreheads.
"Thud!" The bouquet sent by Legers is knocked to the ground.

items.speaker: Nurse
items.text: Everyone shut up! Make any more noise, and I swear I'll anesthetize you so you sleep for the entire month!
They sheepishly retreat under their covers.
J extends his hand toward another Foundation staff member.

items.speaker: J
items.text: I owe you one, "Razor."

items.speaker: "Razor"
items.text: No, you owe Maich one. If she hadn't led us to the door, we wouldn't have been able to stop that girl in time.

items.speaker: Maich the Peddler
items.text: As it turns out, Mercuria foresaw the whole thing and took action before anyone realized what was going on.

items.speaker: Maich the Peddler
items.text: She always does this. Once she's fixed on a goal, she never considers her own safety.

items.speaker: Maich the Peddler
items.text: But, despite her courage, she's still a living person who can get hurt.

items.speaker: Maich the Peddler
items.text: Please, promise me you'll bring her back.

items.speaker: "Razor"
items.text: It's a shame we couldn't arrest that girl. If only we'd had a little more time to prepare.

items.speaker: J
items.text: Cheer up, man! You saved my life, didn't you? That'll get you pretty far on Haight Street.

items.speaker: J
items.text: By the way, where's Matilda? She's supposed to take me to the Foundation today.
He hesitates over his response.

items.speaker: "Razor" Soldier II
items.text: She's been summoned to report on the operation, I guess.

items.speaker: "Razor" Soldier II
items.text: It's gonna be rough. There were a lot of civilians involved, and she didn't follow her commands.

items.speaker: "Razor" Soldier II
items.text: She might even have her position revoked.

items.speaker: J
items.text: What? But we wouldn't have gotten anywhere without her!
A pair of hands come up again to stop him.

items.speaker: Pioneer
items.text: J, that's how things work over there. If you're really planning on joining them, you'll have to learn to follow their rules.

items.speaker: J
items.text: Where's she now?

items.speaker: "Razor"
items.text: We're not authorized to request that information.
Office, St. Pavlov Foundation

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Achoo! Ugh. What's wrong with my nose? This isn't even allergy season yet.

items.speaker: Bernard
items.text: Ms. Bouanich, are you alright?
She stands before her temporary supervisor, preparing herself for the debrief.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Oh, I'm fine. Please, continue!

items.speaker: Bernard
items.text: I read your report last night. I must say that your judgment has given us some very important information.

items.speaker: Bernard
items.text: According to your report, the missing assets are in the possession of Eternity, aside from the most important one, which is now in the hands of Manus Vindictae.

items.speaker: Bernard
items.text: Luckily, the man in control of the girl is one of their insignificant "believers." For the time being, there's a limit to what he can do with her. This, at least, is good news.

items.speaker: Bernard
items.text: You've caused quite a stir among senior management, Ms. Bouanich. It seems you're starting to make a name for yourself.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: *chuckles* Thank you, Mr. Bernard!

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: By the way, I would like to apply to leave the Foundation during my vacation.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: I want to go visit my mother in her safety house.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: That merchant, Eternity, and the peddlers in that lair mentioned her name several times.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: I deem it necessary to confirm her safety.

items.speaker: Bernard
items.text: No problem. Give me the application form. I'll arrange it for you.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Oh, thank you!
She takes an excited step forward.

items.speaker: Bernard
items.text: Oh, wait.
His tone dampens the girl's excitement.

items.speaker: Bernard
items.text: Someone told me to give this to you. He said you left it in San Francisco.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: That's odd. I don't remember leaving anything.
Bernard opens the drawer and places the item into her hand.

items.speaker: Bernard
items.text: He said that it's proof of your promotion.
Depths, Forest
So, what you're saying is that you're not going to turn me back into a toy?
Hmmm. Does that mean I can go hunting by myself? And I can choose my own prey?

items.speaker: Cellar Guardian
items.text: *roars* Kill ... Kill!
There is no sense in his words and as such; no clarity to her purpose.
Oh, no, I mean ...
But she realizes something.
Could you sit down for a moment? Don't worry. All you have to do is say "yes" or "no."

items.speaker: Cellar Guardian
items.text: *roars*
Yes or no?

items.speaker: Cellar Guardian
items.text: *roars* Kill!
The brutish believer swings his hammer wildly.
He runs from one side of the forest to the other, racing east and west with manic energy.
Okay, okay! I get it! I know what you need. This is great!
Her eyes brighten with clarity.
She doesn't need a sensible response; in fact, she doesn't want one. There is a crack in the window; a path to freedom through his madness.
I'll kill whoever you want! As you wish!
Let's decide on our next destination first, shall we?

items.speaker: Cellar Guardian
items.text: *roars*
I see, I see!
She nods eagerly, responding earnestly to his meaningless roars.
She knows that this is a chance for a new beginning.
Then, let's go where you want to go!

items.speaker: Cellar Guardian
items.text: *roars*
She picks up a long, curved branch, using it as makeshift reins to guide the believer to his "desired destination."
From time to time, she glances back, trying to spot the toy on him ...
